subject.title: Feature Request: Pre-tool-call routing hook for model delegation

question: Should OpenClaw support transparent model or session transfer for a pending tool turn, and if so should that authority live in `before_tool_call` or a separate routing hook?
rationale: The choice establishes a security-sensitive plugin API and determines ownership of provider credentials, session state, transcript continuity, permissions, failure handling, and audit records; source inspection cannot infer the intended product boundary.

options.title: Add a dedicated routing hook
options.body: Define a separate, narrowly typed pre-tool routing contract while leaving argument-policy interception in `before_tool_call`; this provides the clearest security and lifecycle boundary.

options.title: Extend the existing hook
options.body: Add context and redirect outcomes to `before_tool_call`, accepting a broader combined policy-and-orchestration API with stricter compatibility requirements.

options.title: Keep delegation explicit
options.body: Decline transparent redirection and require plugins or agents to use explicit subagent/session APIs, documenting that pre-tool hooks remain policy-only.

recommendation.title: Add a dedicated routing hook
recommendation.body: Define a separate, narrowly typed pre-tool routing contract while leaving argument-policy interception in `before_tool_call`; this provides the clearest security and lifecycle boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available routing candidate from the central hook history and previously reviewed this exact product boundary.
